postToolUse.command: bash -lc 'set -e; if git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then if [ -d .github ]; then for p in .github/instructions .github/agents .github/prompts .github/skills; do [ -d "$p" ] || { echo "Missing required customization directory: $p"; exit 1; }; done; fi; fi; echo "Repository customization structure is valid."'

pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$repo = git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { $dirs = @('.github/instructions','.github/agents','.github/prompts','.github/skills'); foreach ($d in $dirs) { if (-not (Test-Path $d -PathType Container)) { Write-Error "Missing required customization directory: $d"; exit 1 } }; Write-Host 'Repository customization structure is valid.' }"
